'''Jesse Wilson''' won the [[1997 Hoth Regionals (Anchorage)]], a qualifier for the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="dec97q">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html 1997 Regionals and Open Events], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990503132332/http://search.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== 1997 World Championship statement ==

Decipher's 1997 World Finals page listed Jesse Wilson as 16 years old and said a biography was unavailable.<ref name="dec97bio">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/wilson.html Jesse Wilson], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990428125157/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/wilson.html Internet Archive]</ref>
